title: Krüsemann and Others v TUIfly (Case C-195/17 and others), 17 April 2018
source: Krüsemann and Others v TUIfly (Case C-195/17 and others), 17 April 2018
excerpt: the spontaneous absence of a significant part of the flight crew staff (‘wildcat strikes’), such as that at issue in the disputes in the main proceedings, [...] is not covered by the concept of ‘extraordinary circumstances’ within the meaning of that provision.
summary: A spontaneous mass absence of flight crew ('wildcat strike') following a surprise restructuring announcement is not an extraordinary circumstance.
